text:
oliver-partners: Hey team — ClearBridge asked us to spin up a joint sandbox for their channel POC. They want a 48h window starting next Tuesday to run load tests, SSO via Okta, and a dedicated egress IP for webhook callbacks. Also flagged a pricing question: can we provide a short-term trial rate for the pilot rather than their devs hitting the normal pay-as-you-go?

jess-sales: Thx, oliver. For pricing we usually do a one-off pilot credit + reduced rate for the first month. Who owns the contracting for channel pilots?

sami-eng: I can handle the infra side. Need clarity on expected TPS and peak seq length. Also: do they need Dedicated capacity or is Hosted with pinned model enough for the run?

oliver-partners: They want ~50 qps sustained, 200 qps burst, mostly chat with 1k token contexts. Prefer Dedicated if we can honor a short SLA.

maria-netops: For the egress IP we need a ticket to networking. We can reserve a NAT and announce the IP, but it takes ~48h to provision and update firewall rules. Also need the tenant name + CIDR for subnet peering.

alan-security: Quick security checklist: SSO via Okta is fine, but we need their SP metadata and expected user count. Also will they upload customer data into the workspace? If yes, we need to enable encryption-at-rest keys and a short DPI review.

jess-sales: ClearBridge said no customer PII in the pilot, just synthetic data. User count ~6 engineers + 2 PMs. I'll get SP metadata today.

sami-eng: With 50 sustained qps and 1k context, Dedicated with 2 GPUs should be ok for the window. I can spin up a small pool with autoscale off and a hard burst cap to control cost. Alan — does that satisfy the security needs?

alan-security: Sounds reasonable. For Dedicated we log to our audit pipeline; need to confirm retention length. Also require we enable session token rotation for the sandbox. I can sign off once we have the SP metadata and a sentence in the SOW about synthetic-only data.

maria-netops: Ticket created: NET-4821. Estimated provisioning ETA 48 hours after approval. Linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sandbox-egress-provisioning

deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted: Scheduled maintenance window check — no conflicts for next Tue 09:00–18:00 UTC.

jess-sales: Action items: (1) I’ll send SP metadata and confirm synthetic data clause (today). (2) Oliver — confirm pilot start window next Tue 09:00 UTC. (3) Sami — prep Dedicated pool config and cost estimate. (4) Maria — follow up on NET-4821 and share public egress IP. (5) Alan — security sign-off once SP + SOW line done.

oliver-partners: Confirmed — ok to aim for Tue 09:00 UTC. Jess, can you also ask ClearBridge if they need workbook access to our telemetry dashboards? They may want token-level cost views for the pilot.

jess-sales: Will ask. If they want token-level dashboards we can enable a read-only Console view — need to add them to a partner role. That’s a 10–15m setup.

sami-eng: I’m preparing a minimal config and a quick smoke test plan. Will post the YAML here when ready.

maria-netops: Noted. Once NET-4821 is approved I’ll allocate the egress IP and post firewall rules. If they need IP allowlisting on their side, give them the IP earliest Tue morning.

alan-security: Minor ask — add a short paragraph to the SOW about data handling and contact for breach reporting. I can draft.

jess-sales: Thanks Alan — please draft and drop it here. I’ll include in the pilot SOW.

oliver-partners: Great. If no objections I’ll schedule a 30m kickoff Tues 08:30 UTC for handoff and run the smoke test at 09:00.

sami-eng: Works for me.

alan-security: Works.

maria-netops: Works — I’ll aim to have NET-4821 resolved by Mon EOD so IP is ready.

jess-sales: All right — I’ll update the partner and share SP metadata + SOW draft by EOD. :thumbsup:

oliver-partners: Thanks everyone. Will check back Monday for final confirmations and to post the YAML from Sami.
